headline: Azerbaijan's Non-Oil and Gas Exports to Exceed $4.2 Billion by Year-End — Minister
summary: Minister of Economy Mikayil Jabbarov made the statement during the first reading of the draft 2027 state budget in parliament.
why: Non-oil export growth reduces reliance on hydrocarbons, which matters for Azerbaijan's fiscal and currency outlook.
